urea.disclaimer_uncertainty: Forecast Uncertainty & Error Compounding Disclaimer: The baseline test RMSE of 21.03 WPI index points was evaluated strictly on one-step-ahead historical predictions. In recursive multi-year forecasting (h=2 and h=3), prior forecasts replace observed values to construct future lags, causing forecast uncertainty to compound over longer horizons. Indicative planning intervals expand with the square root of the horizon (sigma_h = RMSE * sqrt(h)) and serve as analytical decision-support ranges rather than statistically guaranteed economic certainties.
urea.disclaimer_temporal: Historical Data Cutoff & Temporal Baseline Disclaimer: The official DPIIT Wholesale Price Index dataset ends in Financial Year 2022-23 (Base Year 2011-12 = 100.0). Forecasts for 2023-24 onward are algorithmic projections generated by the regularized Ridge regression pipeline, NOT officially notified government index releases. When bridging forecasts to current rupee costs, the user-supplied price baseline and the historical WPI baseline (2022-23) must be evaluated with caution if the current calendar year is later than the cutoff date.
